landing.tagline: A production-ready SaaS starter on Cloudflare.
landing.subtitle: TanStack Start · Better Auth · Drizzle + D1 · shadcn/ui · i18n — typed end to end.
landing.guideStep1: Copy .dev.vars.example to .dev.vars and run pnpm check:env
landing.guideStep3: Seed a master admin + demo data: pnpm seed

features.authBody: Better Auth with organizations, roles, and platform admins.
features.dbBody: Drizzle ORM on Cloudflare D1 with shared queries and zod schemas.
features.i18nBody: react-i18next with a no-hardcoded-strings lint rule.
features.edgeBody: TanStack Start on Cloudflare Workers with health checks and CSP.
features.jobsBody: Cloudflare Workflows plus a typed REST/OpenAPI surface.
features.dxBody: Tests, Storybook, pre-commit hooks, seed + env preflight scripts.
